newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 100 METRES HURDLES CHAMPION ENGQUIST.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 100 METRES HURDLES CHAMPION ENGQUIST.

text.p: Profile of Ludmila Engquist, who won the world 100 metres hurdles title on Sunday.
Won the 1991 world title for Russia as Narozhilenko.
Married her agent, Swede Johan Engquist, and became a Swedish citizen in June 1996 just before Atlanta, where she was the first woman representing Sweden to win an Olympic title.

Was banned for four years after failing a drug test in February 1993. Was reinstated in December, 1995 when the world governing body accepted her explanation that her former husband had given her drugs without her knowledge.
